verdict.rationale: Kong documents a dedicated Rate Limiting plugin, and its GitHub README lists plugins for traffic controls and rate limiting. Separately, AI Gateway docs say it can enforce rate limits on proxied AI traffic. This clearly delivers the core of the story, but the evidence consists of headlines and titles and does not show how limits are scoped. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-consumer and per-route rate-limit scoping, details of the rate-limit configuration (windows, counters, policies), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
